children.label:
crate::scene
Shared drawing primitives and authored draw records.

crate::scene::path
Owned portable path command recordings.

crate::scene::primitives
Pure fill, border and stroke primitives shared with renderers.

crate::scene::recording
Authored draw records and their geometry and text payloads.

crate::scene::shape
Paths, rounded rectangles and shapes in logical pixels.

crate::scroll
Scroll snapping policy and the shared nearest-stop calculation.

crate::semantics
Canonical node semantics, relation mapping and accessible value choices.

crate::semantics::finite
Finite numeric semantics with equality-consistent bit hashing.

crate::semantics::node
Store one canonical node semantics value and map its relation targets.

crate::semantics::validation
Validate declared accessible text runs and selection geometry.

crate::semantics::values
Accessible roles, actions, states and ARIA value choices.

crate::semantics_text
Portable editable text runs, carets and selection snapshots.

crate::text
Text primitives and declared or computed text properties.

crate::text::computed
Resolve inherited typography without losing relative length semantics.

crate::text::primitives
Text alignment, kerning, overflow, case, line height and metrics.

crate::text::properties
Authored text content with declared and computed typography.

crate::text_shaping
Backend-neutral text shaping and measurement queries.

crate::text_utf
Convert clamped UTF-8 byte positions and platform UTF-16 code-unit offsets.

crate::view_transform
Passive uniform content-to-view coordinate transforms.

crate::window
Window identities, native handles and the request to open one.
